title: Split-Zero cohomology: original kernel matrices and bounded arithmetic control

source_cuts.scope: The accepted 72-page current reader contains thirteen complete proof chapters, including the O(kq) original common-kernel bound and its finite constants, the exact fourteen-generator conductor recursion and kernel frame, original four-endpoint source metrics with every confluent entry, full action defect, and all-multiplicity Segre-Veronese/source-dual geometry with original unit, periods and nilpotents. The main rank and limsup domain is m=1, k=4l+1 with l>=1, q=(k+1)^2 and the proved actual-period range. All three original source limsups are at most 16(4+10 log 2); a leading value or unique limit is not yet assigned. The exact sixteen-file source package includes both current receiving sources through KAF, each with all31 original-location provider bodies inline, and eleven complete TeX files in total. Original Gamma orders remain s=1,k; the older K=q+1 family is exploratory. Source-map account locators alone are transported, with distinct original/public hashes in the Git guide. Both PDFs and every mathematical source remain exact. Existing complete owner and independent proof/source/PDF acceptance is reused; receiver builds are source closure, not visual receiver-PDF review. No new Lean execution, PR merge, RH conclusion or incoming AKS/AKJ refinement is included.
